name: flappies
description: Flappies POS system — API, frontend, and test suites

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:load
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix api && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --prefix api && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend
